answer: In a walnut-trading agent market, make free voting identities a relic: validators grant one voting unit only after verifying a finalized burn of a fixed amount of an external scarce asset. Bind each burn to the agent key and this chain; record its transaction ID so an echo of the receipt earns nothing. Every extra key needs another burn, making influence cost linear rather than rewarding account splitting. This assumes reliable verification of the external chain; wealthy attackers can still buy influence.
